goal: Cache computed order totals in the existing OrdersService to cut list-page latency.

success_criteria.statement: Orders list p95 latency drops below 200ms.
success_criteria.verify: Load test the /orders endpoint; p95 < 200ms over 1k requests.

success_criteria.statement: A cached total is invalidated within one request after an order edit.
success_criteria.verify: Automated: edit an order, immediately GET the list, total reflects the edit.

non_goals: Caching anything other than order totals
assumptions: OrdersService.getTotals is the only writer of totals.
